questions.question: The ______ element is a starting element in an HTML, it indicates that document type definition being used by the document.

server_only.explanation: <!DOCTYPE html> is the document type declaration placed at the very top of an HTML5 document to inform the browser about the document specification.

questions.question: The ______ is a tag in HTML that describes some aspects of the contents of a webpage.

server_only.explanation: The <meta> tag placed in the <head> block defines metadata like character encoding, author, description, and keywords.

questions.question: The <ol> tag defines an ______.

server_only.explanation: The <ol> tag defines an ordered (numbered or alphabetized) list.

questions.question: An unordered list was created using the ______ tag.

server_only.explanation: The <ul> element defines an unordered (bulleted) list.

questions.question: The ______ element creates an inline frame.

server_only.explanation: The <iframe> element embeds another HTML document or external webpage inside the current document.

questions.question: ______ tag is used to specify video on an HTML document.

server_only.explanation: HTML5 introduced the native <video> element to play videos without requiring external media plugins.

questions.question: If a web developer wants to add the description to an image he must use the ______ attribute of tag.

server_only.explanation: The 'alt' (alternate text) attribute provides alternative descriptive text if the image fails to load and is indexed by search crawlers.

questions.question: The ______ property is used to set position for an element.

server_only.explanation: The CSS 'position' property determines the positioning scheme used for an element (static, relative, absolute, fixed, or sticky).

questions.question: The float property defines the ______ of content.

server_only.explanation: The CSS 'float' property specifies how an element should float, thereby governing the flow of text and sibling elements around it.

questions.question: ______ is used with elements that overlap with each other.

server_only.explanation: The z-index property specifies the stack order of positioned elements along the z-axis when they overlap.

questions.question: HTML is an Object Oriented Programming Language.

server_only.explanation: HTML is a declarative markup language used to structure content on the web, not an Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) language.

questions.question: Charset is used for character encoding declaration.

server_only.explanation: The charset attribute inside <meta charset='utf-8'> explicitly declares the document character encoding.

questions.question: An unordered list can be numerical or alphabetical.

server_only.explanation: Unordered lists (<ul>) display items using bullets. Numerical or alphabetical lists require an ordered list (<ol>).

questions.question: A multilevel list can be created in HTML5.

server_only.explanation: A multilevel list is formed by nesting one list (ordered or unordered) inside another list item in HTML5.

questions.question: Srccode specifies the HTML content of the page to show in the <iframe>.

server_only.explanation: The valid HTML5 attribute is 'srcdoc', not 'srccode'.

questions.question: The 'controls' attribute is not used to add play, pause, and volume.

server_only.explanation: The boolean attribute 'controls' is explicitly used to display native user controls like play, pause, seek, and volume on <audio> and <video> tags.

questions.question: .cs is the extension of CSS file.

server_only.explanation: Cascading Style Sheets use the '.css' file extension. ('.cs' is used for C# source code files).

questions.question: ______ element used to create a linking image.

server_only.explanation: The <map> tag defines an image map containing clickable geometrical hyperlink zones.

questions.question: The ______ tag is used to embed audio files on Webpages.

server_only.explanation: HTML5 introduced the standard <audio> tag for native sound playback.

questions.question: A programmer wants to define range for age between 18 to 50, he will use a form with following appropriate control.

server_only.explanation: <input type='range' min='18' max='50'> renders a slider control to select values within specified boundary limits.

questions.question: ______ character is used to create id in CSS.

server_only.explanation: CSS ID selectors are prefixed with a hash (#), whereas class selectors use a dot (.).

questions.question: List within another list either ______ list or ______ list is called nested list.

server_only.explanation: Nested lists can contain an ordered (<ol>) or unordered (<ul>) list embedded inside another list item.

questions.question: Image maps are of two types ______ and ______.

server_only.explanation: The two primary classifications of image maps are client-side (<map> and <area>) and server-side.

questions.question: A CSS rule set contains ______ and ______.

server_only.explanation: A complete CSS rule consists of a selector pointing to the HTML element and an enclosed declaration block containing property-value pairs.

questions.question: Client-side image map can be created using two elements ______ and ______.

server_only.explanation: A client-side image map is constructed using the <map> container and nested <area> tags referencing specific clickable shapes.

questions.question: Attributes of <area> tag is ______.

server_only.explanation: The <area> tag accepts attributes such as href, coords, alt, shape, and target.

questions.question: Attributes used with iframe are ______.

server_only.explanation: Standard iframe attributes include src, srcdoc, name, height, and width.

questions.question: Following are the Form controls:

server_only.explanation: email, search, and tel are input control types in HTML5 forms.

questions.question: Attributes used with <audio> tag:

server_only.explanation: The <audio> element supports autoplay, controls, loop, and muted.

questions.question: CSS types are ______, ______ and ______.

server_only.explanation: The three standard implementations of CSS are Inline, Internal, and External.

questions.question: Positioning types in CSS are ______.

server_only.explanation: CSS position values include static, fixed, absolute, relative, and sticky.

questions.question: Types of floating properties are ______, ______, ______.

server_only.explanation: The CSS 'float' property accepts values: left, right, none, or inherit.

questions.question: Match the items from Column A with their corresponding items in Column B.

server_only.explanation: Correct HTML element and CSS property associations.
